name: pdk-experimenter-crash-safe-kinto-publishing
instr:
# Proposal: reliable Nimbus publishing

## Background
Support reliable Nimbus publishing so release managers can submit revisions while earlier collection reviews are in progress. Experimenter schedules collection checks through Celery and stores experiment state in PostgreSQL.

## Proposal
Support durable launch, pause update, and end publishing across worker crashes and parallel collection checks. A launch produces one workspace record in review; signing makes the experiment Live. An approved pause updates `isEnrollmentPaused` in review and in the signed record. An approved end removes the record after review and makes the experiment Complete. Each revision produces one collection change.

## Requirements
- Add a `POST /api/v6/draft-experiments/<slug>/publish/` request for approved launch revisions that requires no request body and accepts with HTTP 202 before the collection check publishes them. The requested revision retains its `userFacingDescription` even if the draft description changes before the collection check.
- A worker killed after Remote Settings accepts a record but before receiving its response resumes without duplicating it or leaving the experiment Approved.
- Concurrent checks on separate workers for one collection never put two experiments in review; after the first review is signed, the next approved experiment can proceed.
